summary: THN & Samios Partners is a CPA accounting and tax advisory firm on George St in Sydney CBD, led by Principal Vania Wang (who acquired Samios Partners in 2019) with Sophie Ding and Sophia Zhang as partners. It offers an accountant-led virtual CFO service with monthly management reporting and works on Xero. Sophie Ding was named a Partner of the Year finalist in the Australian Accounting Awards 2026 and shared the firm's Pay Day Super post in March 2026.

hooks.text: Sophie's Partner of the Year finalist nomination (Australian Accounting Awards 2026) is a recent, public win to open with.
Her Pay Day Super post flags payroll and cash-flow timing; the virtual CFO pack (profit, cash, balance sheet) depends on reconciliations being done early each month.
Virtual CFO clients include multi-entity professional practices and family groups, which multiply reconciliations; the firm works on Xero alongside client bookkeepers whose feeds may arrive messy.

risks.text: Very small firm (1-10 staff, down 10% YoY on LinkedIn); limited seat count and budget.
NSW-based, whereas most of the target list is Victorian.
Titles differ across sources (Sophie is Associate Partner on LinkedIn, Partner on the firm site, Senior Accountant in the awards post and directory listings).

gaps: No podcast, video or Facebook content found.
No job ads found for the firm.
No evidence of tools beyond Xero and 'other major platforms'.
